system.name: ArtiMuse
system.one_liner: Multimodal LLM for image aesthetics assessment that gives both a score and expert-level text on eight fine-grained attributes, with the ArtiMuse-10K dataset.

content.variant_note: eight numbered attribute cards, each a sample image beside a model-written critique, around one central radar chart that carries the scoring claim
content.argues: ArtiMuse writes expert-level critiques on eight aesthetic attributes and also scores images more accurately than other models on five benchmarks.
content.subject: Eight aesthetic attributes shown as sample images with critiques, and a radar chart of six models on five benchmarks.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a model's fine-grained outputs as a ring of equal cards, each a sample beside text with key phrases in one highlight colour, around a single summary chart that carries the quantitative claim, so qualitative breadth and quantitative superiority sit in one view.
lessons.suits: Models that give both detailed text and a score, or any paper that pairs qualitative examples over many attributes with one benchmark summary.

evidence: ArtiMuse provides granular, expert-level textual understanding results for images across 8 ﬁne-grained aesthetic attributes.
it achieves precise image aesthetics scoring, signiﬁcantly outperforming SOTA models across multiple widely-used benchmarks.
superior performance in both quantitative assessment and qualitative explanation, as shown in Fig. 1 and Fig. 2.

summary: ArtiMuse is a multimodal LLM for image aesthetics assessment that gives both a score and expert-level written understanding, trained with the new ArtiMuse-10K dataset. Figure 1 is a three-by-three grid. Eight numbered pastel cards, each with its own border colour, pair a sample painting or photo with a model-written critique whose key phrases are in bold orange: composition and design, visual elements and structure, technical execution, originality and creativity, theme and communication, emotion and viewer response, overall gestalt and comprehensive evaluation. In the centre a radar chart compares six models on five benchmarks (PARA, TAD66K, FLICKR-AES, ArtiMuse-10K, AVA), with the red ArtiMuse polygon enclosing the rest, and three sample images with score bars are pinned around it.
summary_zh: ArtiMuse 是同时给出分数和专家级文字理解的多模态美学评估模型。图1为3×3布局：周围八张编号彩色卡片，各配样图和橙色加粗要点的评语；中央雷达图在五个基准上比较六个模型，红色的ArtiMuse最优。
notes: The radar chart has no frame or title and is not counted as a panel; the eight cards are the panels. The pairing of the three score-labelled images with the radar axes is not stated. The canvas is 482 x 290 pt (ratio 1.66) while the measured content spans about 600 x 316 pt (1.9); the record uses 1.9. The radar labels are outlined glyphs, not live text.
